status: PROPOSED. aq-server main (F5, PR #87) records question decisions and accepts question.answer, but serves no human read of them yet.

capabilities.questions.read: Owner may list and inspect F5 question decisions; gates both routes below.
capabilities.questions.answer: Owner may submit the dashboard-actions-1 kind question.answer (also requires dashboard.actions).

rules: state=open lists pending questions; state=closed lists answered ones. Every item matches the requested state and project.
decision_revision is the positive decimal string the answer must target (subject.revision, expected_versions.decision and payload.expected_revision).
question is the agent's exact text (1..4096 bytes). answer, answered_at_ms and delivery are null while pending and all set once answered.
delivery is {kind: wait} when the answer woke the waiting attempt, or {kind: task_mail, message_id} when it was queued for the continuation.
The authenticated link for one question is the dashboard route /decisions/{decision_id}?kind=question.
